parrafo_1.en: Erica Lopes has been working in the beauty industry for over 13 years. In her studio at Suite 2400A, on NW 33rd Street in Pompano Beach, she handles every appointment herself: root color, balayage, highlights, organic nanoplastia straightening, hair botox, blow dry, gloss and eyebrow design, with the same care visit after visit.
